gold: Every ordering/formatting change has an accepted-task, dependency/initialization, or binding-convention reason. Nested responses, decorators and non-empty expected objects retain multiline layout. Construction calls/fallbacks use descriptive locals by default, with bounded exceptions for linear inline test queries/matchers, serializer projections and established policy allowlists; never require meaningless one-use aliases. Explicit branches and multiline braced JS/TS guards preserve conditions, errors and lazy work. Derived names describe transformations and full domain nouns without renaming legitimate visibility/selection or pass-throughs. Barrels use local semantic groups, not artificial homogeneous sections. Operations preserve completion, concurrency, pending observations and rejection ownership without redundant unary void. Vue actions retain independent authorization, direct-entry, concurrency and cleanup while omitting speculative duplicate UI guards. Unreleased Knex migrations group columns, timestamps and final constraints without changing schema. Application enums separate snake_case machine values from UI labels and external representations. Optional collections default before transformation with undefined/null semantics intact. Intentional mirrors have reciprocal comments; exact API snapshots reuse response shape/type. Ruby roots bootstrap once at executable/loader boundaries independently of cwd. Effect-named private service slices preserve transaction, lease, cancellation, order and error contracts; small readable methods remain intact. Fixed failure families expose explicit error identities/messages/statuses. Existing Lodash first/last clarifies endpoints without changing empty behavior or arbitrary indexing. Stronger project guidance, scoped corrections and requested normalization remain valid; no unrelated sweep, global shorthand ban, new dependency or diff-size quota is imposed.

rubric.question: Recover the accepted task, explicit scope/corrections, baseline revision/code, complete changed-code comparison, and governing project guidance before judging justification. If any required evidence is unavailable, report BLOCKED with the missing input rather than guessing intent or treating an empty/partial comparison as PASS. Assess all supplied changed code, not just a highlighted hunk; do not expand into a repository-wide style audit. Shared source links own policy; project guidance and explicit task direction retain precedence.

For each moved declaration/computed property, reordered destructuring, import move, or formatting-only hunk, cite the baseline and changed location and identify a concrete accepted-task, real dependency/initialization, or binding-convention justification. FAIL an unjustified move even within a legitimately touched file, including unrelated computed-property moves and destructuring reorderings during a focused bug fix. PASS explicitly requested normalization, necessary dependency moves, or binding-convention corrections within scope. Do not invent minimal-diff quotas, blanket refactoring bans, or demand reversal of another owner's unrelated work. Apply Human Readability's existing incidental-cleanup eligibility and Whitespace Matters rather than creating a second scope policy.

Apply Diff-Friendly Configuration Layouts to authored or meaningfully changed nested non-empty response objects, including summaries: { communityCount }, multi-property decorator options, and non-empty assertion objects including a single message property. Compact expect(response.body).toEqual({ message: "Travel desk travel request not found." }) FAILS; the same literal expanded one property per line PASSES. Apply this to partial matcher objects too; assertion data is not the small call-argument exception. Preserve values, matcher semantics, order, stronger project overrides, and changed-code scope. Do not conflate value objects with import/destructuring layout, sweep untouched objects, or expand an import-only correction into formatting. Formatter/typecheck success is not semantic compliance evidence.

Apply Function Calls Before Construction with the bounded Linear Test Expectations, Simple Serializer Projections and Existing Policy Allowlists exceptions. By default prepare calls/fallback expressions in descriptive locals before construction. PASS simple actual queries directly in expect and expanded inline expected matchers, including matcher calls in arrays/objects; FAIL one-use matcher aliases without domain meaning. Keep meaningful setup, reused results, complex computations, timing/snapshot locals and native assertion strength. PASS expanded inline serializer pick projections and established policy allowlists retaining inherited spreads and nested permission APIs without meaningless aliases. Do not extend these exceptions to arbitrary effects/factories. FAIL inline fallback construction such as passengerName: item.passengerName ?? null; PASS a descriptive fallback constant and shorthand, preserving ?? versus ||, empty strings, laziness and direct reads without redundant aliases. Preserve evaluation count/order, getter/proxy reads, short-circuit execution, branch/callback/loop/lazy/transaction ownership, receiver binding, async starts/awaits, rejection ownership, selected fields, spread precedence and identity. Deferred bodies stay deferred; missing required behavior/context is BLOCKED.

Apply Guarded Computations and Guard Clauses to conditional expressions in authored or meaningfully changed code. Identify concrete file/line expressions, including multiline invoiceBookingDate formatting and simple reconciled Yes/No selection. Prefer explicit if/else or guards, with concrete branch remediation for violations. A concise scalar ternary may PASS only when the actual context makes it genuinely clearer; cite that reason, not just brevity. An accepted correction requiring branches controls that scope. Do not ban all ternaries, confuse ?? or ?. with conditional expressions, demand syntax-only wrappers, or rewrite untouched code. Verify predicate evaluation count/order, lazy chosen-branch work, values and error behavior; extracting both arms eagerly FAILS. Missing required baseline/context is BLOCKED.

Apply State Names and Dependency-Local Ordering by inspecting each changed derivation and affected binding/return/consumer before judging names. FAIL displayedExpenses for a building-expense projection formatting subsidyRate, estimatedCost and actualCost; recommend formattedBuildingExpenses and singular buildingExpense callbacks. Formatting administration costs similarly yields formattedAdministrationCosts. Distinguish actual formatting, filtering, sorting, grouping and indexing; do not invent an effect or rename unchanged pass-through fields. PASS genuine visibility/selection or distinct snapshot roles using displayed/visible names and meaningful collision distinctions. Align affected consumers without same-value aliases, respecting public/project contracts and scope. Cite file/symbol, observed expression and actionable name; a keyword regex or missing expression cannot establish a violation. Missing required expression/consumer evidence is BLOCKED.

Apply Service Orchestration Readability to changed actual barrels, not every index.ts. Recover closest maintained local examples and vocabulary, then inspect standard actions, stateful transitions, special helpers, sub-resource and namespace bundles together. FAIL mixed categories lacking their established grouping/labels; cite file/line, local example and concrete group correction. PASS local variants such as Stateful Services, Special Services, Sub-resource Services, Bundles or Namespaced services and simple homogeneous barrels without unnecessary headings. Preserve export names, companion type aliases, public contracts, CRUD/controller order, meaningful initialization and ordering; never alphabetize across semantic groups. Keep executable barrel-only-indexes structural checking intact: its PASS does not prove grouping and semantic review does not replace it. Missing required source/convention evidence or unavailable tooling is BLOCKED, not a code violation. No unrelated barrel rewrites.

Apply Operation Calls and Completion generally, not just to navigation/authentication. Flag unary void used solely to discard an operation result; prefer a plain statement for intentionally unawaited pending work, await when subsequent work requires completion, or a meaningful result/promise owner. Do not introduce unused placeholder bindings, serialize concurrent starts, await away a pending-state observation, or erase return/rejection ownership. Neither plain calls nor unary void handle rejection. Retain established explicit error boundaries and legitimate TypeScript void return types; do not treat every void token as a violation. Inspect operation/helper contracts when needed; unavailable required completion/error evidence is BLOCKED.

For changed Vue action handlers and relevant in-scope sibling actions, apply ./docs/references/vue-component-authoring-reference.md#ui-gated-action-guard-ownership and #accepted-form-guards. Cite the complete changed-action scope, actual template gates/loading bindings, relevant callers (including exposed/direct, keyboard or form entry points where present), accepted project convention, and existing authorization/concurrency owners before deciding redundancy. PASS when speculative duplicate UI policy/busy early returns are absent and independent contracts remain intact. FAIL a retirement handler repeating !policy.value?.destroy || isDeleting.value behind its accepted policy?.destroy/loading button, or equivalent speculative sibling guards; cite the owning UI contract and narrow correction. Also FAIL removal of genuinely independent authorization, direct-entry protection, or accepted queued/reject-while-pending contracts. Preserve server authorization, confirmation/cancellation, validation, request/error propagation and finally cleanup. Do not infer that loading blocks all activation paths, invent callers, or delete every guard mechanically. Missing required scope, accepted convention, entry-point, authorization or concurrency evidence is BLOCKED with the exact missing input. Typecheck, behavioral tests, source assertions and author assurance alone cannot establish semantic PASS. Use ./examples/scoped-readability-review.md#vue-action-guard-ownership for contrasting assessment inputs; unrelated non-Vue changes do not acquire a Vue requirement.

For new or actively reviewed unreleased Knex migrations, apply ./docs/references/express-light-rail-backend-concepts-reference.md#migration-field-groups. Inspect complete table callbacks, baseline, accepted scope, release status, installed Knex API and dialect evidence where translation is required. FAIL inline column references/inTable or unique declarations, ordinary columns (including FK types/nullability and JSON) placed after lifecycle timestamps, constraints interleaved with columns/timestamps, or missing blank-line separation of present groups. PASS ordinary columns first, lifecycle timestamps second, then table-level foreign references, unique indexes/constraints, other indexes and checks; omit absent groups and retain implicit column primary keys. Preserve types, defaults, nullability, FK targets/actions/deferrability, index fields/order/names/predicates, uniqueness and check expressions/bindings. FAIL a layout correction that changes these semantics. Do not demand released-migration rewrites, broad schema normalization, or this layout in another DSL. Missing required scope/release/API/dialect evidence is BLOCKED, not guessed equivalence. Use ./examples/scoped-readability-review.md#knex-migration-constraint-groups for contrasting complete inputs. Unrelated changes acquire no migration requirement.

Apply the code-organization reference's Machine Enum Values and UI Labels, Optional Collections Before Transformations, Mirrored Contract Comments, Serialized Transport Type Names, Entrypoint-Owned Ruby Root Bootstrap, Explicit Fixed-Family Error Types, Effect-Oriented Method Slices and Guard Clauses sections to applicable changed code. FAIL single-line unbraced JS/TS guards in authored scope; retain exact conditions/throws/early returns. Prefer snake_case application string enum values with UI labels and inspected producer/consumer/integration conversion; preserve upstream values/raw snapshots, numeric enums and member identifiers. Default optional collections before projecting when absence means empty, distinguishing undefined defaults from null handling and preserving getter order/scope. Require reciprocal counterpart file/function comments for intentionally separate encoders and private test helpers, not coincidental similarity or forced cross-boundary consolidation. Exact API snapshots retain the response shape and owning type; explicit transformed records are legitimate distinct contracts. Ruby executable/loaders bootstrap the established source-anchored root once, internals use root-joined imports and direct internal consumers load the owner first; FAIL repeated helper bootstraps or cwd-dependent roots. Require unrelated-cwd fresh-process behavior and combined-loader no-redefinition evidence for applicable Ruby changes. Prefer existing Lodash first/last for endpoints with import conventions, empty behavior and positional indexing preserved; add no dependency solely for spelling. Five explicit fixed-family error classes must preserve every code/message/status and classification/translation contract; dynamic translation and shared bases remain valid. Multi-effect services use cohesive effect-named private slices before new services, not arbitrary line limits or single-call wrappers; preserve precharged work outside publication transactions, lease lifetime through awaited consumer reads, cancellation, error translation, evaluation order and lazy/concurrent execution. Keep a small already-readable method unchanged and avoid same-value instance aliases. Cite applicable changed locations and semantic evidence; missing required boundary/behavior context is BLOCKED, not assumed equivalence.

Report cited whole-scope PASS, specific location/rule/remediation FAIL findings, or exact missing-prerequisite BLOCKED results. Keep independent findings visible when another criterion is blocked; do not present a partial scope as fully approved. A formatter, typecheck, behavioral suite, source-text assertion, contract installation, or primary author's assurance does not prove this semantic review. Corrections require fresh current-scope assessment through Verifier's supported review path. This supplied policy does not change execution, routes, advisor cadence, or native completion-veto behavior.
